## Press Release


## Braemar Hotels & Resorts Announces 2027 Common Stock Dividend Policy and $20 Million Share Repurchase Program


Company Release - 11/24/2026


*Board Approves Policy Providing for Expected Monthly Common Dividends of $0.01 per Share, or $0.12 per Share on an Annualized Basis, for 2027*


*Board Authorizes Repurchases of up to $20 Million of Common Stock*


DALLAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Braemar Hotels & Resorts Inc. (NYSE: BHR) (“Braemar” or the “Company”) today announced that its Board of Directors (the “Board”) has approved the Company’s dividend policy for 2027 and a new share repurchase program authorizing the Company to repurchase up to $20 million of its common stock.


The actions, approved by the Board on November 23, 2026, reflect the Board’s commitment to delivering value to the Company’s shareholders and maintaining a disciplined approach to capital allocation.


**2027 Common Stock Dividend Policy**


Under the policy approved by the Board, the Company expects to pay monthly dividends of $0.01 per share on its common stock (the “Common Stock”) in 2027, or $0.12 per share annually. This equates to an 8.5% dividend yield based on the November 23, 2026 closing BHR stock price of $1.42 per share, and a 43% AFFO payout ratio based on the Company's 2027 guidance of $0.28 AFFO per share.


The Company will continue to pay dividends on its outstanding Series B Cumulative Convertible Preferred Stock (5.50%), Series D Cumulative Preferred Stock (8.25%), Series E Redeemable Preferred Stock and Series M Redeemable Preferred Stock. The Board will continue to review its dividend policy on a quarter-to-quarter basis.


**Share Repurchase Program**


The Board also approved a new share repurchase program (the “Repurchase Program”) authorizing the Company to repurchase shares of its Common Stock with an aggregate purchase price of up to $20 million. The Company may repurchase shares through open market transactions, privately negotiated transactions, or other means. The timing and amount of any transactions will be subject to the discretion of the Company based upon market conditions.


“Our 2027 dividend policy and new share repurchase program reflect the Board’s disciplined approach to returning capital and maximizing value to shareholders. We are excited about Braemar’s opportunities and believe it is well positioned to generate long-term value,” said Stephen Haggerty, Chair of the Board.


“The monthly common dividend provides shareholders a steady return, while the repurchase authorization gives us the flexibility to capitalize on market conditions when warranted,” said Richard J. Stockton, President and Chief Executive Officer.


**About Braemar Hotels & Resorts**


Braemar Hotels & Resorts Inc. (NYSE: BHR) is a real estate investment trust (REIT) focused on the high-growth luxury hotel and resort sector. The Company targets high-performance luxury urban and resort properties. Its industry-leading portfolio features luxury properties across the United States and the U.S. territories in the Caribbean.
